# Node reference

<!-- Generated by tests/unit/docs.test.ts from the generator registry: do not edit. -->
<!-- Regenerate with `npm run docs`. -->

99 nodes. Every shader node's GLSL can be shown and edited in the editor
(Code button of the Generator page); see [authoring.md](authoring.md) to write new ones.
Parameters are uniforms `u_<key>` (float, int for int/select, bool, vec3 for colors,
vec2); ranges are the slider ranges, typed values may go up to the "typed" limits.

## Simulations

### Reaction-Diffusion `reaction-diffusion`

Gray-Scott model (see karlsims.com/rd.html). Paint with the mouse: left adds B, right/shift erases. Seamless.

- Kind: GPU simulation (stateful; not convertible to code), animated (reads `u_time`)
- Inputs: `seed` Seed (float) — Bright areas of this input seed the simulation (restarts it when connected). (`u_in_seed`, `u_has_seed`); `map` f/k map (float) — Brightness varies feed / kill across the image (± the spreads below), blending several patterns in one texture. Replaces the f/k variation mode. (`u_in_map`, `u_has_map`)
- Presets: Coral growth (Sims default), Mitosis, Spots / solitons, Worms, Maze, Holes, Fingerprint, Chaos, Pulsating, U-Skate world, Parameter map (f across X, k across Y), Radial transition, Swirling stripes (anisotropic)

| Param | Uniform | Type | Range / options | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Feed (f) `feed` | — | float | 0 … 0.12 (typed: 0 … 0.48) | 0.055 |  |
| Kill (k) `kill` | — | float | 0.03 … 0.075 (typed: 0.03 … 0.21) | 0.062 |  |
| Diffusion A `diffA` | — | float | 0.2 … 1 (typed: 0.2 … 3.4) | 1 |  |
| Diffusion B `diffB` | — | float | 0.1 … 0.8 (typed: 0.1 … 2.9) | 0.5 |  |
| f/k variation `mapMode` | — | select | 0 None, 1 Gradient (f→X, k→Y), 2 Radial | 0 | Vary feed/kill across the image to blend several regimes (Karl Sims "map"). The f/k map input replaces it with any image. |
| Feed spread `feedSpread` | — | float | 0 … 0.06 (typed: 0 … 0.24) | 0.02 |  |
| Kill spread `killSpread` | — | float | 0 … 0.02 (typed: 0 … 0.08) | 0.005 |  |
| Anisotropy `anisotropy` | — | float | 0 … 0.6 (typed: 0 … 2.4) | 0 | Diffuse faster along a direction to get oriented stripes. |
| Direction field `directionMode` | — | select | 0 Fixed angle, 1 Swirl, 2 Radial | 0 |  |
| Angle `direction` | — | float | 0 … 180 (typed: 0 … 720) | 0 |  |
| Steps / frame `stepsPerFrame` | — | int | 1 … 64 (typed: 1 … 127) | 16 |  |
| Time step `dt` | — | float | 0.1 … 1 (typed: 0.1 … 3.7) | 1 |  |
| Grid size `simResolution` | — | select | 128 128, 256 256, 512 512, 1024 1024 | 256 | Larger grids give finer detail (slower). |
| Seed `seedMode` | — | select | 0 Center square, 1 Random spots, 2 Noise, 3 Ring, 4 Text, 5 Empty | 1 |  |
| Seed text `seedText` | — | text |  | RD |  |

### Flowmap Painter `flowmap-painter`

Paint flow directions by dragging and watch them animate a water surface. Exports the encoded flowmap (RG = direction). Right-drag erases.

- Kind: GPU simulation (stateful; not convertible to code), animated (reads `u_time`)
- Presets: River (lit water), Whirlpool, Turbulent curl, Debug checker, Paint from scratch

| Param | Uniform | Type | Range / options | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Enable Preview `preview` | — | bool |  | true | Show the flow applied to a pattern. |
| Layout `previewLayout` | — | select | 0 Split (drag the bar), 1 Full | 0 |  |
| Split position `splitPos` | — | float | 0.02 … 0.98 (typed: 0.02 … 3.86) | 0.5 |  |
| Pattern `previewPattern` | — | select | 0 Water (lit), 1 Water normal map, 2 Checker, 3 Grid, 4 Noise | 0 |  |
| Pattern scale `previewScale` | — | float | 1 … 32 (typed: 1 … 125) | 4 |  |
| Cycle speed `flowSpeed` | — | float | 0 … 3 (typed: 0 … 12) | 0.6 | Flow cycles per second (the shader loops with two blended phases). |
| Flow strength `flowStrength` | — | float | 0 … 4 (typed: 0 … 16) | 1 |  |
| Direction arrows `arrows` | — | bool |  | true | Overlay on the encoded map (never exported). |
| Arrow grid `arrowDensity` | — | int | 4 … 48 (typed: 4 … 92) | 16 |  |
| Flip green (DirectX) `flipGreen` | — | bool |  | false | Encode +Y as down, as expected by DirectX-convention engines. |
| Flow magnitude `brushStrength` | — | float | 0 … 1 (typed: 0 … 4) | 1 |  |
| Opacity `brushOpacity` | — | float | 0.02 … 1 (typed: 0.02 … 3.94) | 0.6 |  |
| Softness `brushSoftness` | — | float | 0 … 1 (typed: 0 … 4) | 0.7 |  |
| Brush size `brushSize` | — | float | 0.005 … 0.2 (typed: 0.005 … 0.785) | 0.06 |  |
| Smoothing `relax` | — | float | 0 … 1 (typed: 0 … 4) | 0.1 | Continuously relaxes the field. |
| Start from `initial` | — | select | 0 Neutral, 1 Fixed direction, 2 Swirl, 3 Curl noise | 1 | Initial field, painted over. A gentle base flow keeps the preview moving. |
| Start strength `baseStrength` | — | float | 0 … 1 (typed: 0 … 4) | 0.35 |  |
| Direction `baseAngle` | — | float | 0 … 360 (typed: 0 … 1440) | 0 |  |
| Steps / frame `stepsPerFrame` | — | int | 1 … 4 (typed: 1 … 7) | 1 |  |
| Grid size `simResolution` | — | select | 128 128, 256 256, 512 512 | 256 | Larger grids give finer detail (slower). |

### Physarum `physarum`

Slime-mold transport networks (Jeff Jones model): veins, webs, organic lattices. Paint food to attract agents.

- Kind: GPU simulation (stateful; not convertible to code), animated (reads `u_time`)
- Inputs: `food` Food (float) — Bright areas attract the agents (e.g. an Image, Paint Mask or pattern). (`u_in_food`, `u_has_food`)
- Presets: Veins, Fine web, Coarse network, Cells / Voronoi, Rings, Dense mycelium, Lightning roots, Soft fog, Rival colonies, RGB territories

| Param | Uniform | Type | Range / options | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sensor angle `sensorAngle` | — | float | 5 … 90 (typed: 5 … 345) | 30 |  |
| Sensor distance `sensorDistance` | — | float | 1 … 40 (typed: 1 … 157) | 9 | In trail pixels. |
| Turn angle `turnAngle` | — | float | 5 … 90 (typed: 5 … 345) | 30 |  |
| Speed `moveSpeed` | — | float | 0.2 … 4 (typed: 0.2 … 15.4) | 1 | Pixels per step. |
| Wander `wander` | — | float | 0 … 60 (typed: 0 … 240) | 5 | Random heading jitter (degrees). |
| Agent count `agentCount` | — | select | 64 4k, 128 16k, 256 65k, 512 262k | 256 |  |
| Spawn `spawn` | — | select | 0 Uniform, 1 Disc (outward), 2 Ring (inward) | 0 |  |
| Species `species` | — | select | 1 1, 2 2 (R, G), 3 3 (R, G, B) | 1 | Competing populations, each with its own trail channel: they follow their own trail and avoid the others’ (graphic RGB networks; use source colors to see them). |
| Repulsion `repulsion` | — | float | 0 … 3 (typed: 0 … 12) | 1 | How strongly an agent avoids the other species’ trails. |
| Deposit `deposit` | — | float | 0.01 … 2 (typed: 0.01 … 7.97) | 0.3 |  |
| Decay `decay` | — | float | 0.005 … 0.5 (typed: 0.005 … 1.985) | 0.1 |  |
| Diffusion `diffuse` | — | float | 0 … 1 (typed: 0 … 4) | 0.6 |  |
| Steps / frame `stepsPerFrame` | — | int | 1 … 8 (typed: 1 … 15) | 2 |  |
| Grid size `simResolution` | — | select | 128 128, 256 256, 512 512, 1024 1024 | 512 | Larger grids give finer detail (slower). |
| Brush size `brushSize` | — | float | 0.005 … 0.2 (typed: 0.005 … 0.785) | 0.03 |  |
| Exposure `gain` | — | float | 0.05 … 4 (typed: 0.05 … 15.85) | 0.6 |  |
| Food strength `foodStrength` | — | float | 0 … 3 (typed: 0 … 12) | 0.4 | Bright areas of the Food input keep emitting attractant: the network grows toward them and links them (Karl Sims / Jones "nutrients"). |

### Ink Marbling `marbling`

Paper marbling (ebru / suminagashi): ink bands swirled by a flow field. Paint drops ink. Seamless.

- Kind: GPU simulation (stateful; not convertible to code), animated (reads `u_time`)
- Inputs: `seed` Seed (float) — Bright areas of this input seed the ink pattern (restarts it when connected). (`u_in_seed`, `u_has_seed`)

### Smoke & Fire `smoke-fire`

Smoke with optional emitter and flow inputs. Outputs density with alpha or motion vectors.

- Kind: GPU simulation (stateful; not convertible to code), animated (reads `u_time`)
- Inputs: `emitter` Emitter (float) — Bright areas of this input emit smoke (e.g. a shape, text or glow node). (`u_in_emitter`, `u_has_emitter`); `flow` Flow (vec2) — Flowmap (RG around 0.5) pushing the fluid, e.g. the Flowmap Painter. (`u_in_flow`, `u_has_flow`)
- Presets: Rising smoke, Campfire, Puff trail, Magic vortex ring, Side wind, Comet trail, Spiral wisps, Motion vectors

## Operators

### — Operators —

### Output `output`

Chooses what to export and show in the library. Falls back to the selected node when unconnected.

- Kind: shader (`vec4 generate(vec2 uv)`, convertible to code in the editor)
- Inputs: `image` Image — The image to export. (`u_in_image`, `u_has_image`)
- Presets: Output

### Reroute `reroute`

A dot that bends links (double-click a link to add one).

- Kind: shader (`vec4 generate(vec2 uv)`, convertible to code in the editor)
- Inputs: `image` In — Passed through. (`u_in_image`, `u_has_image`)
- Presets: Reroute

### Blend `op-blend`

Foreground over Background with a blend mode, opacity and optional mask.

- Kind: shader (`vec4 generate(vec2 uv)`, convertible to code in the editor)
- Inputs: `foreground` Foreground — Image blended on top. (`u_in_foreground`, `u_has_foreground`); `background` Background — Image underneath. (`u_in_background`, `u_has_background`); `mask` Mask (float) — Brightness limits where the foreground shows. (`u_in_mask`, `u_has_mask`)
- Presets: Normal, Add (glow), Multiply (shade), Overlay, Difference

| Param | Uniform | Type | Range / options | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mode `mode` | `int u_mode` | select | 0 Normal, 1 Add, 2 Subtract, 3 Multiply, 4 Screen, 5 Overlay, 6 Lighten, 7 Darken, 8 Difference, 9 Divide | 0 |  |
| Opacity `opacity` | `float u_opacity` | float | 0 … 1 (typed: 0 … 4) | 1 |  |
| Invert mask `invertMask` | `bool u_invertMask` | bool |  | false |  |

### Mask `op-mask`

Cuts the Image with a Mask (luminance, alpha or red), with levels and invert.

- Kind: shader (`vec4 generate(vec2 uv)`, convertible to code in the editor)
- Inputs: `image` Image — The image to process. (`u_in_image`, `u_has_image`); `mask` Mask (float) — White keeps, black removes. (`u_in_mask`, `u_has_mask`)
- Presets: Soft mask, Hard cut, Inverted

| Param | Uniform | Type | Range / options | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mask channel `channel` | `int u_channel` | select | 0 Luminance, 1 Alpha, 2 Red | 0 |  |
| Low `low` | `float u_low` | float | 0 … 1 (typed: 0 … 4) | 0 |  |
| High `high` | `float u_high` | float | 0 … 1 (typed: 0 … 4) | 1 |  |
| Invert `invert` | `bool u_invert` | bool |  | false |  |

Levels, gamma, power, multiply, add, fold, threshold, invert and clamp.

| Direction `angle` | `float u_angle` | float | 0 … 360 (typed: 0 … 1440) | 0 | Directional mode. |

Smears the Image along the slopes of another image (Substance slope blur): painterly strokes, eroded or swollen edges.

| Samples `samples` | `int u_samples` | int | 1 … 64 (typed: 1 … 127) | 12 | Steps along the slope: more gives longer, smoother strokes. |

### Distance `op-distance`

Distance fields inside or around a mask. An optional Source spreads colors from the shapes.

- Presets: Gradient around, Bevel, Signed field, Soft glow

| Threshold `threshold` | `float u_threshold` | float | 0 … 1 (typed: 0 … 4) | 0.5 |  |

### Unpack RGBA `op-unpack`

Splits an image into its R, G, B and A channels: one grayscale output each.

- Kind: shader (`vec4 generate(vec2 uv)`, convertible to code in the editor)
- Inputs: `image` Image — The image to process. (`u_in_image`, `u_has_image`)
- Outputs: `r` Red, `g` Green, `b` Blue, `a` Alpha
- Presets: Split channels

### Pack RGBA `op-pack`

Packs four grayscale masks into the R, G, B and A channels of one texture (export with source colors).

- Kind: shader (`vec4 generate(vec2 uv)`, convertible to code in the editor)
- Inputs: `red` Red (float) — Stored in R. (`u_in_red`, `u_has_red`); `green` Green (float) — Stored in G. (`u_in_green`, `u_has_green`); `blue` Blue (float) — Stored in B. (`u_in_blue`, `u_has_blue`); `alpha` Alpha (float) — Stored in A (opaque when unconnected). (`u_in_alpha`, `u_has_alpha`)
- Presets: Packed

| Param | Uniform | Type | Range / options | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Opaque preview `preview` | `bool u_preview` | bool |  | false | Ignore the alpha input in the preview (it can hide everything). |

### Custom Code `op-custom`

Apply your own GLSL to up to three inputs. The starting color is input A.

- Kind: shader with a GLSL code parameter (`code`)
- Inputs: `a` A — Read with a(uv); also the starting value of v. (`u_in_a`, `u_has_a`); `b` B — Read with b(uv). (`u_in_b`, `u_has_b`); `c` C — Read with c(uv). (`u_in_c`, `u_has_c`)
- Presets: Invert, Multiply A × B, Stripes from A, Height to normal

| Param | Uniform | Type | Range / options | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GLSL `code` | — | text |  | v.rgb = 1.0 - v.rgb; | Ctrl+Enter applies. Compile errors appear on the node. |

### — Animation —

### Hue Shift `op-hue-shift`

Rotates the hue over time; Spread makes rainbow bands travel with brightness.

- Kind: shader (`vec4 generate(vec2 uv)`, convertible to code in the editor), animated (reads `u_time`)
- Inputs: `image` Image — The image to process. (`u_in_image`, `u_has_image`)
- Presets: Slow drift, Rainbow bands, Static tint

| Param | Uniform | Type | Range / options | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Speed `speed` | `float u_speed` | float | -2 … 2 (typed: -14 … 14) | 0.1 | Turns of the color wheel / s. |
| Offset `offset` | `float u_offset` | float | 0 … 360 (typed: 0 … 1440) | 0 |  |
| Spread `spread` | `float u_spread` | float | 0 … 3 (typed: 0 … 12) | 0 | Hue change with brightness. |
| Saturation `saturation` | `float u_saturation` | float | 0 … 3 (typed: 0 … 12) | 1 |  |

### Color Cycle `op-color-cycle`

Scrolls image brightness through the color ramp over time.

- Kind: shader (`vec4 generate(vec2 uv)`, convertible to code in the editor), animated (reads `u_time`)
- Inputs: `image` Image — The image to process. (`u_in_image`, `u_has_image`)
- Presets: Lava flow, Water shimmer, Neon rainbow

| Param | Uniform | Type | Range / options | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Speed `speed` | `float u_speed` | float | -3 … 3 (typed: -21 … 21) | 0.25 | Palette loops / s. |
| Repeats `repeats` | `int u_repeats` | int | 1 … 12 (typed: 1 … 23) | 1 | Palette bands across the image. |
| Mirror `mirror` | `bool u_mirror` | bool |  | true | There and back through the ramp: no hard jump between its ends. |

### Flicker `op-flicker`

Brightness or opacity pulses over time: sine, candle-like noise or strobe; Local makes each area flicker on its own.

- Kind: shader (`vec4 generate(vec2 uv)`, convertible to code in the editor), animated (reads `u_time`)
- Inputs: `image` Image — The image to process. (`u_in_image`, `u_has_image`)
- Presets: Candle, Breathing, Shimmer, Strobe

| Param | Uniform | Type | Range / options | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wave `wave` | `int u_wave` | select | 0 Sine, 1 Noise, 2 Strobe | 1 |  |
| Speed `speed` | `float u_speed` | float | 0.05 … 12 (typed: 0.05 … 47.85) | 2 | Cycles / s. |
| Amount `amount` | `float u_amount` | float | 0 … 1 (typed: 0 … 4) | 0.5 |  |
| Local `local` | `float u_local` | float | 0 … 1 (typed: 0 … 4) | 0 | Phase varies across the image. |
| Affect opacity `opacity` | `bool u_opacity` | bool |  | false | Fade the alpha instead of the brightness. |

### Scroll `op-scroll`

Pans the image over time, wrapping around (seamless inputs scroll endlessly), with an optional sway.

- Kind: shader (`vec4 generate(vec2 uv)`, convertible to code in the editor), animated (reads `u_time`)
- Inputs: `image` Image — The image to process. (`u_in_image`, `u_has_image`)
- Presets: Rising, Diagonal drift, Heat haze

| Param | Uniform | Type | Range / options | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Speed X `speedX` | `float u_speedX` | float | -2 … 2 (typed: -14 … 14) | 0 | Tiles / s. |
| Speed Y `speedY` | `float u_speedY` | float | -2 … 2 (typed: -14 … 14) | 0.25 | Tiles / s. |
| Sway `sway` | `float u_sway` | float | 0 … 2 (typed: 0 … 8) | 0 |  |
| Sway waves `swayWaves` | `int u_swayWaves` | int | 1 … 8 (typed: 1 … 15) | 2 |  |
| Sway speed `swaySpeed` | `float u_swaySpeed` | float | 0 … 4 (typed: 0 … 16) | 0.5 |  |

### Dissolve `op-dissolve`

Dissolves along a pattern with a glowing edge. Without a pattern, wipes left to right.

- Kind: shader (`vec4 generate(vec2 uv)`, convertible to code in the editor), animated (reads `u_time`)
- Inputs: `image` Image — The image to process. (`u_in_image`, `u_has_image`); `pattern` Pattern (float) — Dark parts go first (noise, gradient, Distance…). (`u_in_pattern`, `u_has_pattern`)
- Presets: Burn away, Magic fade, Hard cut

| Param | Uniform | Type | Range / options | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Speed `speed` | `float u_speed` | float | 0.02 … 4 (typed: 0.02 … 15.94) | 0.25 | Cycles / s. |
| Edge width `edge` | `float u_edge` | float | 0 … 0.5 (typed: 0 … 2) | 0.08 |  |
| Edge glow `glow` | `float u_glow` | float | 0 … 8 (typed: 0 … 32) | 2 |  |
| Glow color `glowColor` | `vec3 u_glowColor` | color |  | #ff7a1a |  |
| Ping-pong `pingPong` | `bool u_pingPong` | bool |  | true | Disappear, then reappear. |
| Invert pattern `invert` | `bool u_invert` | bool |  | false |  |
